subject: Insurance
title: The Maui Wildfire Tragedy
description: A quick, practical guide to The Maui Wildfire Tragedy.

hook.text: In August 2023, a wildfire destroyed Lahaina, Maui, killing over 100 people.

buildup.text: Hurricane-force winds pushed flames through the historic town in hours. Residents had minutes to flee.

discovery.text: Insured losses are estimated at $5-6 billion. But many Lahaina residents were underinsured.

twist.text: The utility company, Hawaiian Electric, faces billions in lawsuits for not shutting off power during high winds.

climax.text: Maui's fire showed that wildfire risk exists far beyond California.

punchline.text: An entire town destroyed in hours. Maui proved wildfire risk is everywhere.

quiz.question: What made the Maui wildfire particularly devastating?
options: Hurricane-force winds spread it rapidly through a historic town
